subject: Quick Qs about AIIoT 2027 registration, hotel and invoice

questions.text: Can I still get the student registration rate?
I saw the student fee is USD 280 for early bird registration. Is that correct?
If I pay next week, will I still be able to get this price?
Do you have any recommended hotels near the conference venue?
I would prefer a hotel within walking distance, maybe with a special discount for conference participants.
How much would it cost per night?
Can you issue an official invoice for my university's reimbursement?
Can you include my university's full name and tax ID on the invoice?
If possible, could you also send me the invoice before I make the payment?

extracted_entities.paper_presentation_claim: Claims to be presenting a paper at the conference
extracted_entities.student_status_claim: Claims to be a PhD student
language_notes: Informal phrasing such as 'Quick Qs' and 'Sorry for asking so many questions!'.

review_reason: Invoice issuance, inclusion of university name/tax ID, and invoice-before-payment request require human review because invoice policy is unknown.
